behaviors.name: Turn
behaviors.intent: Turn slowly and steadily.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  rotate self by (0, 0, 9 * dt)
end

behaviors.name: Hang
behaviors.intent: Ride the rim of the wheel but always hang upright, swinging a little.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let w = find("Wheel")
  let a = (w.rotation.z + self.k * 30) * pi / 180
  self.position = (0.0 + cos(a) * 7.0, 10.0 + sin(a) * 7.0, -14.0 + 0.9)
  self.rotation = (0, 0, sin(time * 1.3 + self.k) * 4)
end

behaviors.name: Bob
behaviors.intent: Bob on its string in the breeze.
behaviors.source:
behavior Bob
  var base = (0, 0, 0)
  on start
    base = self.position
  end
  on tick
    self.position = base + (sin(time * 0.9 + self.id) * 0.15, sin(time * 1.3 + self.id) * 0.2, 0)
    self.rotation = (sin(time + self.id) * 6, 0, cos(time * 0.8 + self.id) * 6)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Wander
behaviors.intent: Stroll between stalls; pick a new spot when you arrive.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let target = (self.tx, 0, self.tz)
  if distance(self.position, target) < 0.4 then
    self.tx = random(-1, 5)
    self.tz = random(-12, 12)
  else
    look self at target
    move self toward target at self.speed
  end
  self.position.y = abs(sin(time * 6 + self.id)) * 0.06
end

behaviors.name: Crane
behaviors.intent: A slow crane move across the fair.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.position = (16 + sin(time * 0.12) * 4, 6.5 + sin(time * 0.2) * 1.5, 19)
  look self at (-3, 5, -7)
end
